Developer traces a concrete partial/blocked source replay to model binding, path mapping, parser, internal coverage, or detector logic.
A detector change is permitted only for a reproducible precision/soundness defect with positive/fixed/safe/unrelated controls.
Tester independently replays the same commit; concrete regressions return to development.
Second-layer model reviews only the resulting small source-bound candidate set and records evidence/unknowns.
